question: Two cement laboratories report conflicting Blaine specific-surface results on the same retained cement sample. How should an independent research agent distinguish apparatus calibration, sample density, bed porosity and conditioning effects before recommending a grinding-circuit change?
scenario: Disagreement between plant and external laboratory Blaine measurements despite matched nominal cement grade
evidence_required: Split-sample custody, homogenization, storage humidity, temperature and testing timestamps for both laboratories
Blaine apparatus identification, reference material certification, calibration dates, manometer or timer records, and test method editions
Measured cement density, weighed sample mass, packed-bed porosity, replicate results, analyst technique and laboratory uncertainty budgets
answer_and_decision_guide: Confirm both laboratories used a comparable valid method and representative split of the same material. Recalculate the specimen mass and permeability conversion using each apparatus calibration and measured density; compare replicate distributions and reference-material checks. Separate genuine fineness differences from specimen conditioning, packing and instrument effects. Obtain accredited laboratory review of unresolved discrepancies before changing separator speed or grinding parameters. Do not equate Blaine surface area alone with particle-size distribution or strength.
source_provenance: Seller-maintained research navigation only; validate testing against the applicable current ASTM C204 or EN 196-6 edition and laboratory accreditation scope, not this seller page.
free_first_decision: First use existing lab calibration certificates, retained split samples, method documentation and a free transparent reconciliation worksheet; do not purchase reference material if the discrepancy can be resolved from those records.

conditional_paid_check.authorization: Only consider a paid package if an exact listed file and edition meet the unmet task; verify current price, preview, permitted use and seller rights, and obtain explicit buyer authorization. No automatic purchase.

model_limitations: No measured Blaine replicates, density, porosity, calibration coefficients or certified reference results were supplied. The agent cannot declare either laboratory correct or prescribe mill settings.
